Tess: Quick idea : run a compact PLG test: 25-min "Quickstart Lab" webinar + 30 starter credits + 3 ready prompts. Hypothesis: combo cuts TTFS and lifts D7 active by ~20%.
Arjun: Nice. Primary metric: % new signups with >=1 successful gen within 24h and TTFS <= 10m. Secondary: gen_count_7d, retention_d7.
Maya: Cohorts: control | credits_only | webinar_only | combo. If traffic small, run sequential 4-week waves.
Tess: Landing CTA test: "Reserve lab + claim credits" vs "Try now get starter credits". Include one-click "run sample" for logged-in users, otherwise a curl snippet.
Arjun: Tracking params: utm_source=lab_banner&utm_campaign=qlab_v1&arm=combo. Event schema: signup_source, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_24h, ttfs, retention_d7. QA required.
InfraBot: Promo pool created: qlab_pool_2026 (2000 codes). API: POST /api/assign_promo {user_id,pool} -> {code,expires_at}. Single-use, expiry 14d. Auth via service token.
Maya: Prompt templates: "Short outreach", "Feature brainstorm (3 bullets)", "Data->insights (1-paragraph)". Keep low-token examples.
Arjun: Owners: Tess = landing + social narrative; Maya = templates + script; InfraBot = promo integration; Arjun = metric spec & analysis plan. Drafts by Thu EOD.
Tess: I'll draft social benchmark copy: factual angle "reduced time-to-first-prompt" with a small benchmark table. Will post link here when ready. :rocket:
Maya: Weekly check-in Wed 9am PT. If any infra issues, ping InfraBot.
InfraBot: Reminder: maintenance window 1876600000-1876603600 UTC. Avoid major deploys then.
